repos.name: browserbase/stagehand
repos.description: The SDK for browser agents. Interact, search, extract, and fetch any site reliably across the web
repos.one_liner: A specialized SDK designed to build reliable, production-grade browser agents.
bullets: Built on TypeScript with deep integration for Playwright and LLM-based automation.
Provides robust primitives for web interaction, data extraction, and site navigation.
Ideal for building autonomous research agents, automated testing suites, and web-scraping pipelines.
Focuses on reliability and error handling for complex, dynamic web environments.

repos.name: supermemoryai/supermemory
repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.one_liner: A scalable, local-first memory and context engine designed to serve as the long-term storage layer for AI agents.
bullets: Uses a high-performance TypeScript stack with local vector database capabilities.
Acts as a centralized Memory API to provide persistent context to LLMs and agentic workflows.
Enables privacy-focused data management by allowing full local execution.
Useful for building personalized AI assistants that require deep historical context and knowledge retrieval.

repos.name: trycua/cua
repos.description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
repos.one_liner: An open-source infrastructure platform for scaling computer-use agents across cross-OS fleets.
bullets: Provides standardized drivers and benchmarks for training and evaluating agentic computer-use models.
Supports fleet management for distributed agent deployment across diverse operating systems.
Facilitates large-scale data generation for fine-tuning models on GUI-based tasks.
Essential infrastructure for enterprises looking to deploy autonomous agents in production environments.

repos.name: scadastrangelove/awesome-ai-security-tools
repos.description: A curated list of public-source, research, and commercial tools for AI security and AI-assisted cybersecurity — autotriage, agent security, AI/ML supply chain, pentest agents, AI SAST, LLM-driven fuzzing, threat intelligence, SOC/SIEM triage, reverse engineering, LLM red-teaming, and more.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive repository of tools dedicated to AI security, LLM-driven fuzzing, and AI supply chain protection.
bullets: Curated collection of Python-based security frameworks, pentest agents, and AI SAST tools.
Covers critical domains including AI/ML supply chain integrity and agentic security posture.
Provides a centralized resource for security professionals to audit and harden AI-integrated systems.
Supports automated triage and vulnerability detection in LLM-powered applications.

repos.name: autonomous-ai/openharness
repos.description: One device to harness all AI agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and more — across computers and servers.
repos.one_liner: A unified interface and orchestration layer for managing multiple AI agents across local and remote infrastructure.
bullets: TypeScript-based orchestration layer designed to bridge disparate agent ecosystems like Claude Code and Cursor.
Simplifies the management and deployment of agentic workflows across servers and workstations.
Provides a standardized harness for monitoring and controlling agent behavior in complex environments.
Useful for developers managing multi-agent systems that require centralized control and observability.
